description: This Java source file defines a custom exception class 'AclEntryInvalidException' used within the Eclipse Ditto project. The exception indicates an invalid Access Control List (ACL) entry, is marked as deprecated, and provides builder methods for construction from messages or JSON objects. It extends DittoRuntimeException and implements ThingException, and includes handling for JSON parsing, HTTP status codes, and headers.

classes.name: AclEntryInvalidException
classes.description: A deprecated, immutable Java exception class representing an invalid ACL entry in the Eclipse Ditto project. Provides static factory methods and a builder for instantiation, and supports JSON parsing and schema versioning.

classes.name: AclEntryInvalidException.Builder
classes.description: A thread-unsafe builder class for constructing instances of AclEntryInvalidException with optional customization of message, description, cause, and link.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Returns a new builder instance for creating AclEntryInvalidException objects.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Creates a new AclEntryInvalidException with a specified message and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a new AclEntryInvalidException from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: getSupportedSchemaVersions
methods.description: Returns the JSON schema versions supported by this exception class, specifically version 1.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Creates a copy of this exception with updated DittoHeaders.
